description: Methane Tracker Database is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by IEA (International Energy Agency (IEA)). The database is subject to the IEA’s Terms and Conditions, available at This database presents the IEA’s country-by-country estimates of energy-related methane emissions. For the oil and gas sector, we present detailed estimates for the abatement potential, and costs or savings, from different technology and policy options. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in CSV. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
